hook.text: TikTok, YouTube, and gaming compete for the same hours that television once owned. Attention is finite.

buildup.text: Young viewers spend more time on short-form video than on any streaming service. The format itself is shifting.

discovery.text: Television adapted before. It survived radio skeptics, cable fragmentation, and internet doomsayers.

twist.text: But this time is different. The competition isn't another TV format. It's an entirely different way of consuming media.

climax.text: Television will survive by evolving. The 30-minute sitcom may die, but storytelling through screens will not.

punchline.text: Television keeps dying. It keeps coming back as something new.

quiz.question: What new threat does television face that differs from previous disruptions?
options: Competition from entirely different media formats like short-form video and gaming
